title: Among the schools with an SAT excellence rate of over 0.3, what is the high
question:
Among the schools with an SAT excellence rate of over 0.3, what is the highest eligible free rate for students aged 5-17?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Excellence rate = NumGE1500 / NumTstTakr; Eligible free rates for students aged 5-17 = `Free Meal Count (Ages 5-17)` / `Enrollment (Ages 5-17)`

auxiliary_raw_evidence_draft.base_sql:
SELECT MAX(f.XCL_020)
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON f.XCL_001 = s.XCL_030
WHERE s.XCL_039 > 0.3

base_solution_anchor.base_sql:
SELECT MAX(f.XCL_025 * 1.0 / f.XCL_024)
FROM frpm f
JOIN satscores s ON s.XCL_030 = f.XCL_001
WHERE s.XCL_036 > 0 AND (s.XCL_040 * 1.0 / s.XCL_036) > 0.3
  AND f.XCL_024 > 0;
